explanation: The agreement’s own article says what it was for: it was “signed on 27 January 1973 to establish peace in Vietnam and end the Vietnam War”, and it “included a cease-fire, which was scheduled to take effect at 24:00 GMT on 27 January”. A peace is a thing a war produces and this atlas writes that as `caused`, as it does for the armistice of 22 June 1940 and the Korean armistice. It is `probable` and not `consensus` because the only work cited is one encyclopedia.
